summary: Every thing we do is openly documented and everything we use is open software. Our goal is to hope other networks like @oer_cameroon spread and we create tools for #OpenScience. We don't need a new shiny platform, when we have the web.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Every thing we do is openly documented and everything we use is open software. Our goal is to hope other networks like @oer_cameroon spread and we create tools for #OpenScience. We don't need a new shiny platform, when we have the web.
